title: The Fortune Teller and the Co-Owner

scenes.title: The Fortune Teller on the Street
scenes.summary: A street fortune teller predicts a surprise promotion for Chef Barinov, while Nastya scolds Kostya at home before leaving early.

scenes.title: Mikhail's Gambling Loss
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov rescues Mikhail after a disastrous card game in room 207, while Kostya brings Nastya her forgotten phone at the restaurant.

scenes.title: Morning Champagne
scenes.summary: Kostya accidentally spills champagne on an irritable hotel guest, and a tipsy Mikhail steps in as hotel manager to smooth things over.

scenes.title: Nastya's Secret Call
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov advises Mikhail to quit gambling before Eleonora calls him upstairs, and Kostya overhears Nastya whispering on the phone.

scenes.title: Eleonora's Offer
scenes.summary: Eleonora and Dmitry Nagiyev surprise Chef Barinov by offering to make him an equal co-owner of the hotel restaurant.

scenes.title: The Magazine Column
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov celebrates becoming a co-owner with Elena, who reveals she was offered a magazine column about Moscow restaurants.

scenes.title: The Swiss Bank
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov convinces Elena to leave her restaurant job and write full-time, promising they will soon be rich while eyeing their wedding savings.

scenes.title: Kostya's Confession
scenes.summary: Believing Nastya is about to confess to an affair, Kostya launches into an emotional speech about forgiveness and promises to fix all his bad habits.

scenes.title: New Chairs and Nikita
scenes.summary: Nastya tells a baffled Kostya she only wanted to say goodnight, and the next day Nikita's millionaire father tries to lure him back to his own restaurant.

scenes.title: Bad News
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov rewards the street fortune teller and hears another ominous prophecy, while Kostya tells Senya he saw Nastya meeting an older man.

scenes.title: Olivier with a Woman
scenes.summary: At the bar, Nikita tells Denis and Kostya that he saw Katya's French admirer Olivier dining with another woman, and they hire a private detective.

scenes.title: Working at a Loss
scenes.summary: Eleonora informs Chef Barinov and Nagiyev that the restaurant is losing money because guests dislike the expensive, tiny auteur portions.

scenes.title: Two Million Rubles
scenes.summary: Refusing to abandon his Michelin star dream, Chef Barinov agrees to invest one million rubles as co-owner to cover the restaurant's losses.

scenes.title: Where to Get a Million
scenes.summary: Eleonora tells Nagiyev her plan to force Barinov back to the old menu, while Barinov admits to Mikhail that his only million is his wedding fund.

scenes.title: Watching the Hotel Room
scenes.summary: Mikhail tells Chef Barinov he is going to win his money back tonight, while the detective reports that Olivier ordered dinner for two in his room.

scenes.title: The Fortune Teller's Advice
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov consults the street fortune teller about the wedding money, and she tells him to follow Mikhail to multiply it.

scenes.title: The Business Partner from Paris
scenes.summary: Kostya attacks the older man with Nastya, while Denis and Nikita bring Katya to Olivier's room, only to discover the woman inside is Olivier's business partner.

scenes.title: Chef's Compromise
scenes.summary: Nastya stops Kostya from punching his own father, and Chef Barinov admits to Eleonora that he lost the money, proposing a compromise menu.

scenes.title: Eleonora's Strategy
scenes.summary: At home, Eleonora reveals to Nagiyev that she hired the fortune teller and rigged the card game so Chef Barinov would stay hungry for a Michelin star.

scenes.title: Kostya's Father and Katya's Dinner
scenes.summary: Nastya explains she tracked down Kostya's estranged father as a family surprise, while Olivier invites Katya to enjoy the molecular dinner together.
